title: Wacom’s Movinkpad 11 is a fun and mid-priced entry point for digital artists
summary: But I am a tech enthusiast and was interested to see how a digital art newbie like myself might use a device like the Movinkpad. Movinkpad also comes with its own free digital art software, Wacom Canvas .
